sources.title: Real Property Transfer Tax and Measure ULA FAQ
sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance
sources.note: City base 0.45% ($2.25/$500). ULA 4% above $5.4M and 5.5% at/above $10.9M for closings after 2026-06-30; thresholds CPI-indexed annually.

sources.title: Documentary Transfer Tax
sources.note: County $0.55 per $500; for the five special cities (including Los Angeles) the county line is computed at $1.10 per $1,000; City of LA adds $2.25 per $500 plus ULA tiers.

sources.title: California Constitution, Article XIII A (Proposition 13)
sources.note: Verified text: full cash value base may reflect an annual inflation adjustment 'not to exceed 2 percent', and may be reduced for substantial damage or decline in value.

sources.note: Three classes (Moderate/High/Very High); maps rank hazard not risk; SRA effective 2024-04-01; for Local Responsibility Area the page directs owners to the local jurisdiction.

sources.title: Incidents — current emergency incidents and seasonal outlook
sources.note: 2026 YTD: 6,389 wildfires, 339,481 acres, 3 fatalities, 177 structures destroyed. Southern California outlook through Feb 2027: below-normal significant fire potential.
